projects.title: Support Triage Assistant
projects.tagline: Intake -> FastAPI + Pydantic validation -> policy-grounded triage -> Slack human approval.
projects.brief: Build a production-minded customer support triage backend triggered by an incoming email/webhook workflow. Instead of relying on ad-hoc prompts inside n8n UI nodes, enforce typed Pydantic request/response contracts, deterministic escalation rules (billing disputes, missing order IDs, angry sentiment keywords), cited knowledge-base snippets, and explicit human review before any reply reaches the customer.
requirements: Expose authenticated FastAPI endpoints (`POST /v1/triage`, `GET /healthz`, `GET /readyz`) with `SecretStr` startup validation.
Validate inbound email payloads and LLM structured outputs using strict Pydantic v2 `BaseModel`, enums/literals, and field validators.
Enforce deterministic code overrides: any ticket mentioning refunds/chargebacks or missing required IDs MUST set `requires_human = True` regardless of LLM confidence.
Cite exact retrieved/policy IDs in suggested drafts; reject fabricated citations deterministically.
Deduplicate duplicate incoming message IDs via `Idempotency-Key` / `message_id` tracking.
Emit single-line JSON structured logs carrying `X-Request-Id` while scrubbing customer email/bearer credentials.

# Support Triage Assistant

## Problem Statement
Automate customer support intake classification, policy citation, and draft preparation while keeping financial actions and external email sends strictly behind human approval.

## Architecture
- **Ingress**: n8n webhook/email trigger attaching `Idempotency-Key` and `X-Request-Id`.
- **Service**: Python FastAPI backend enforcing Pydantic schemas, deterministic escalation rules, and PII-redacted JSON logging.
- **Safety Gate**: High-risk categories (`billing`, `urgent_outage`, low confidence, prompt injection) force `requires_human=true`.

projects.title: Document Processing Pipeline
projects.tagline: ACLs + hybrid RAG retrieval + cited answers + clean document updates & deletion.
projects.brief: Create a knowledge-grounded document ingestion and question-answering pipeline that handles real-world company docs (Markdown, PDF text, JSON handbooks) without falling into tutorial RAG traps. Include structure-aware chunking with provenance metadata, tenant/role metadata filtering (`AuthZ`), hybrid keyword + vector retrieval, grounded citation verification, and lifecycle updates/deletions.
requirements: Ingest documents with stable `doc_id`, `version`, `tenant_id`, `role_required`, and section headers in metadata.
Preserve paragraph/heading boundaries during chunking with overlap rather than blindly splitting mid-sentence.
Enforce mandatory server-side metadata filters (`tenant_id == caller.tenant_id`) inside every retrieval query BEFORE prompt assembly.
Combine vector similarity with keyword/BM25 lexical search so exact error codes and invoice IDs match reliably.
Refuse cleanly (`status='insufficient_context'`) when retrieval returns low relevance or missing sources—never fabricate citations.
Support idempotent re-ingestion and cascade document deletion so updated/removed docs leave zero orphaned stale chunks.

                                     |

projects.title: Human-Approved Research Workflow
projects.tagline: Stateful LangGraph orchestration + bounded tool budgets + durable `interrupt()` approval.
projects.brief: Implement a stateful multi-step research & action preparation graph using LangGraph (only where state cycles and pause/resume genuinely justify it). The graph gathers source findings across bounded research iterations, validates every tool return value, compiles a structured dossier + proposed external action, pauses cleanly via durable checkpoint persistence waiting for a human operator's explicit decision (`approve` / `edit` / `reject`), and resumes safely without repeating completed lookups.
requirements: Define an explicit typed `GraphState` (with bounded reducers for `findings` and monotonic `step_count`).
Enforce strict loop & tool-call budgets (`max_steps`, `tool_budget`) routing deterministically to final synthesis or human escalation on exhaustion.
Validate every tool argument AND tool return payload before feeding back into state (fail gracefully on malformed external results).
Persist state across pauses using a real durable checkpointer keyed by stable `thread_id`.
Isolate risky side-effect steps behind LangGraph `interrupt(...)` BEFORE sending emails, Slack broadcasts, or CRM writes.
Support clean resume (`Command(resume=...)`) handling both Approve, Edited-Draft, and Reject paths cleanly.
projects.architectureDiagram:
[Start Request + thread_id]
          |
          v
  [Node: Plan / Formulate Queries]
          |
          v
  [Node: Bounded Tool Execution] <---+ (Loop ONLY while findings incomplete
          |                             AND step_count < max_steps!)
          +--> [Conditional Edge: Budget hit OR Enough info]
          |
          v
  [Node: Draft Dossier & Proposed Action]
          |
          v
  [INTERRUPT: Persist Checkpointed State & Wait for Human]
          |
     (Operator sends Approve / Edit / Reject via Command(resume=...))
          |
     +----+----+
     |         |
  Approved   Rejected
     |         |
     v         v
 [Idempotent  [Abort & Log]
  Side Effect]

# Human-Approved Research Workflow (LangGraph)

## Why LangGraph Was Earned Here
A simple single-call chain could not track iterative source accumulation, persist pauses across hours of human review, or cleanly reject/edit pending actions without losing state.

## Architecture & Guardrails
- Bounded state reducer + hard `max_steps` termination routing.
- Durable checkpointer keyed by `thread_id` surviving restarts.
- First-class `interrupt()` before external write actions + idempotent post-resume dispatch.

## Verification
- Run graph & safety tests: `pytest tests/test_graph.py`
- Verified paths: Approve, Edit-before-send, Reject, Max-step exhaustion, Duplicate-resume idempotency.

projects.title: n8n + Python AI Service
projects.tagline: Full hybrid stack: Docker Compose + reverse proxy / Cloudflare Tunnel + async 202 callback + ops backups.
projects.brief: Unify everything into one production-ready hybrid automation platform: n8n handles SaaS triggers, OAuth integrations, Slack human approvals, and email dispatch; your Python FastAPI service handles Pydantic validation, ACL-safe RAG, LangGraph approval/async orchestration, idempotency, observability, and automated tests. Package both cleanly in Docker Compose behind a TLS reverse proxy / Cloudflare Tunnel + Access architecture with backup/restore verification.
requirements: Co-locate n8n, FastAPI, worker (or async runner), and Postgres on a private Docker Compose network (`http://fastapi-api:8000`)—keep Postgres & internal endpoints unexposed publicly.
Implement async `202 Accepted` + signed callback pattern cleanly so slow AI runs never time out n8n HTTP Request nodes or Cloudflare edge proxies.
Authenticate BOTH directions: n8n -> FastAPI (`Authorization: Bearer` / HMAC) AND FastAPI callback -> n8n webhook (signed header + secret verification).
Configure n8n reverse-proxy env variables (`WEBHOOK_URL`, `N8N_PROXY_HOPS`, `EXECUTIONS_DATA_PRUNE`) cleanly and document Cloudflare Access separation between Editor UI vs `/webhook/*`.
Route exhausted retries / bad payloads to a persistent failure queue + Slack ops notification without losing incoming trigger data.
Ship non-root Dockerfile, `.dockerignore`, `/healthz` + `/readyz` checks, `pg_dump` backup + verified restore drill, and honest architecture/runbook docs.
projects.architectureDiagram:
[Gmail / Customer Webhook]
         |
         v
[Reverse Proxy / Cloudflare Edge (TLS 443 + WAF)]
  |-- Human UI (/): Protected by Cloudflare Access SSO + n8n Auth
  |-- Machine (/webhook/*): Bypass interactive SSO -> Verifies Signature!
         |
         v
[n8n Container (:5678, private Compose net)]
  |-- HTTP Request -> http://fastapi-api:8000/v1/jobs (Bearer + Idempotency-Key)
  |-- Receives 202 Accepted immediately!
         |
         v
[FastAPI + Background Worker + LangGraph + Postgres]
  |-- Validates -> ACL RAG -> Pauses for Human Slack Approval
  |-- Signs & posts result -> n8n Callback Webhook
  |-- Unrecoverable failure -> Dead-Letter Queue + Ops Alert
